captures.what_is_new: IBM's Sports Tech Startup Challenge, launched at Web Summit Lisbon 2025 for growth-stage startups building AI-powered solutions for the business of sports, ends at Web Summit Lisbon 2026: a showcase on 10 November (the post says six startups; five are listed: Proximity Works Inc., More Rewards, Game Intuit, N Tangible, Valarita Sports) and an invitation-only Prize Challenge on 11 November with six confirmed finalists (LingoPal, Fanory, Neuron Systems, LivXP, PressBox, TwelveLabs), with judges from IBM, FIFA, Ferrari and CNN as listed. The Grand Prize includes up to 100,000 US dollars for an eligible proof-of-concept project with IBM's sports partnerships team, up to 20,000 dollars in IBM credits and mentorship, subject to IBM's rules. Participation rests on IBM's own post; descriptions are IBM's.

Go Coimbra, with IPN and the University of Coimbra, brings 12 selected startups to Web Summit for all four days, in digital health, AI, robotics, sustainability and aerospace technology; the stand promises a robot in a Coimbra student cape and a Coimbra guitar performance with an electronic touch. The startups are not named and no stand location is given.
